evidence.source_name: Royal Conquest Pirate Ship — official source
supports: The Royal Conquest is a 90-minute cruise around Boca Ciega Bay.
The Royal Conquest is a bi-level, 46-foot pirate ship that can hold up to 46 passengers.
Cruise activities include a Water Gun Battle, Treasure Hunt, Pirate Story, Music and Limbo.
Departure times listed are 11:30 a.m., 1:30 p.m., 4:30 p.m. and 7:00 p.m., and times may vary.
Children receive a Paper Pirate Hat, Pirate Certificate and Beads.
